clue.text: Service flat — and what buyer hopes it goes for?

parts.note: flat as in level or smooth, so even

parts.words: what buyer hopes it goes for
parts.note: a buyer hopes to get something for a song, that is very cheaply

explanation.surface: An apartment is up for sale, and the clue wonders what price the purchaser is hoping for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service flat' reads as one phrase, a rented flat with cleaning laid on, but 'Service' is the definition and 'flat' gives EVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the evening church service of the Anglican tradition.

clue.text: Showing up brother or sister in wicked situation

indicators.note: in tells us the sibling word sits inside the word for wicked

parts.note: wicked means vile
a sibling, abbreviated SIB

explanation.surface: A sibling turns up in some nasty predicament.
explanation.definitionFit: Something showing up is in plain view, which is the adjective's sense of being seen.

clue.text: Man resounds when performing Puccini aria

indicators.note: performing suggests the letters of the words man resounds are put through their paces into a new order

explanation.surface: A tenor's voice rings out as he sings a famous operatic number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when performing' rearranges the eleven letters of MAN RESOUNDS.
explanation.definitionFit: Nessun Dorma is the tenor aria from Puccini's opera Turandot, famous from football broadcasts.

clue.text: Preserved old Mediterranean resort sol

parts.note: Nice is the resort city on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: An old seaside town on the Mediterranean has been kept just as it was.
explanation.walkthrough: The held clue ends with a stray 'sol' that the OCR picked up; the wordplay needs only O plus NICE.
explanation.definitionFit: Food kept on ice is chilled to preserve it, and figuratively a plan on ice is held in reserve.

clue.text: Bomb opponents brought into class

indicators.note: brought into says one piece is put inside the word for class

parts.note: class means grade, a level or rank
in bridge East and North are opponents of South and West, giving E and N

explanation.surface: Someone sneaks an explosive past rivals into a school classroom.
explanation.walkthrough: Bridge partners sit opposite each other, so any two adjacent compass points, here E and N, are 'opponents'.
explanation.definitionFit: A grenade is a small bomb thrown by hand.

clue.text: I'm about to remove fielder

indicators.note: about tells us the letters of I'm turn round

parts.note: I'm written without the apostrophe
to doff is to take off, as a hat

explanation.surface: Someone announces they are just going to take something off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns IM into MI. MID-OFF is a cricket fielding position near the bowler on the off side.
explanation.definitionFit: Mid-off is a cricket fielding position, and by extension the player standing there.

clue.text: Famous spy giving no thanks to his R W ONE revolutionary spiritual leader

indicators.note: giving no tells us the word for thanks is dropped from the spy's name

parts.note: Mata Hari was the dancer executed as a German spy in 1917
TA is British informal for thanks

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests the letters of his are turned over into a new order

explanation.surface: A notorious spy is linked to a radical guru.
explanation.walkthrough: The held clue carries stray letters 'R W ONE' from the OCR; the wordplay is MATA HARI less TA, then an anagram of HIS ('revolutionary') giving SHI.
explanation.definitionFit: A maharishi is a Hindu sage or teacher, a title meaning great seer.

clue.text: Sauce of a pickpocket

definitions.meaning: a thick sauce for dunking food into

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a creamy dip at a party, and a dip as a thief who picks pockets.

clue.text: Cook vegetable that's fine for starter

indicators.note: for starter tells us the abbreviation for fine replaces the first letter of the vegetable

parts.note: salsify is a root vegetable
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction to prepare a vegetable that has turned out well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cook' as in cooking the books: falsifying figures. SALSIFY loses its first S to F.
explanation.definitionFit: To cook accounts or results is to falsify them, a common idiom.

clue.text: Famous building he's modelled with plasticine

indicators.note: modelled suggests the clay is shaped into something new, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: he's without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: A man has made a model of a famous monument out of children's modelling clay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'modelled' rearranges the letters of HES and PLASTICINE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sistine Chapel in the Vatican is famous for Michelangelo's ceiling.

clue.text: Annoyingly slow old vehicle — about time it reached end of route

indicators.note: about says the vehicle wraps around the time letter

parts.note: a bus is a vehicle

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of route

explanation.surface: An ancient bus crawls along until it finally reaches the last stop.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone obtuse is slow to understand, maddeningly dim.

clue.text: Word puzzle of convoluted sort one found in a small volume

indicators.note: found in tells us the scrambled letters sit inside the other pieces

parts.note: CC, cubic centimetres, is a small unit of volume

indicators.note: convoluted means twisted, so the letters of sort are mixed

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Some tangled kind of puzzle turns up in a slim book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'convoluted' rearranges SORT plus I into ROSTI, which goes between the two Cs after A.
explanation.definitionFit: An acrostic is a puzzle or poem in which initial letters spell a word.

clue.text: Vegetable that's well advanced, number one to be lifted

parts.note: a spring is a natural well or water source
on means forward or advanced

indicators.note: in a down clue lifted means the letters read upwards, backwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A gardener's top vegetable is coming on nicely and ready to pull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be lifted' turns NO plus I into ION.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring onion is a young onion eaten raw in salads, also called a scallion.

clue.text: Stream of maitre d's failing to serve one

indicators.note: failing to serve says the letter for one is left out of the waiters' word

parts.note: a maitre d' is a head waiter
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Restaurant managers fail to look after a diner.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is a complaint about service; the definition 'Stream' sits at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Headwaters are the streams forming the source of a river.

clue.text: Note way it makes return in the City, YOYO without interest

parts.note: A is a musical note
a path is a way

indicators.note: in places the turned-round word inside the City's letters

parts.note: EC is the postcode of the City of London

indicators.note: makes return means it is read backwards

explanation.surface: A memo about a road coming back into the financial district bores everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: The held clue carries a stray 'YOYO' from the OCR. The City is London's financial district.
explanation.definitionFit: Apathetic means showing no interest or enthusiasm.

clue.text: Put up sound beams

indicators.note: sound tells us the word for put up is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to put up is to raise

explanation.surface: Someone erects acoustic girders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' here is the homophone signal, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: rays are narrow beams of light or radiation shining from a source.

clue.text: Rastafarian leaders turned to emperor

indicators.note: turned means the leading letters are read backwards

parts.note: the leading four letters of Rastafarian; that they sit at the word's front is no coincidence, 'leaders' points there

explanation.surface: Followers of Rastafari change allegiance to an emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: Fittingly, Rastafarians revere an emperor, Haile Selassie; here 'leaders' means the front letters RAST, turned to give the Russian ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsar was the emperor of Russia.

clue.text: What in France is found in Med? A tree

indicators.note: is found in says the French word goes inside the word for Med

parts.note: the Med is the Mediterranean Sea
quoi is French for what

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about something discovered in the Mediterranean.
explanation.definitionFit: The sequoia is the giant redwood tree of California.

clue.text: A timeless lie comes to trouble expert

indicators.note: timeless says the time letter is removed

parts.note: a fiction is an untruth
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: An undying lie is going to cause bother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'timeless' takes T (time) out of FICTION, leaving FICION.
explanation.definitionFit: An aficionado is a keen and knowledgeable devotee of a pursuit.

clue.text: Where one may have cooked any meat and The that's available

definitions.text: Where one may have cooked any meat
definitions.meaning: meat simmered in broth is cooked in a stock
goods on the shelves ready to sell

explanation.walkthrough: The held clue carries stray words 'and The' from the OCR; the two definitions are the cooking pot and 'available'.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop item in stock is available; meat cooked in stock sits in broth.

clue.text: Raises collection with a positive gesture?

definitions.text: Raises collection with a positive gesture?

indicators.note: in a down clue raises means the letters read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a set is a collection
a nod signals yes

explanation.surface: Someone gives generously to a collection with a nod of approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raises' turns SET, A and NOD together to read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who donates gives money, the generous act the whole clue pictures.

clue.text: Drinks from gourds

explanation.definitionFit: Squash is both a fruit cordial drink and a gourd vegetable such as butternut.

clue.text: Second in relative quantity

indicators.note: in tells us the short time goes inside the relative

parts.note: an aunt is a relative
MO, a moment, is a short time like a second

explanation.surface: Second place among relatives in number.
explanation.definitionFit: An amount is a quantity or sum.

clue.text: A barrier, it's said, to love

indicators.note: it's said tells us the words for a barrier are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a door is a barrier

explanation.surface: A barrier is said to stand in the way of love.
explanation.definitionFit: To adore is to love deeply.

clue.text: I might train sight on loriot?

definitions.text: I might train sight on loriot?

indicators.note: to train is to guide or rework, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher speaks of focusing binoculars on an oriole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' rearranges SIGHT ON LORIOT; a loriot is an old name for the golden oriole.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird expert would train binoculars on a rare bird such as the oriole.

clue.text: Take minutes over game

indicators.note: over says the abbreviation is turned upside down in this down clue

parts.note: MIN is the standard abbreviation for minutes; that it is also the front of the word is a coincidence

explanation.surface: Someone takes their time over a game.
explanation.walkthrough: Nim is a game of taking matchsticks; NIM is also an old verb meaning take, so 'Take' doubles as a hint.
explanation.definitionFit: Nim is a mathematical game where players take objects from heaps.

clue.text: Time? Real ale drinkers knocked back something for the road

indicators.note: knocked back suggests swallowing a drink and also reading backwards

parts.note: CAMRA is the Campaign for Real Ale, a British beer drinkers' group

explanation.surface: Closing time is called and beer lovers down one for the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' turns CAMRA into ARMAC; CAMRA is a British society promoting traditional cask beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarmac is the road surfacing material, a mix of tar and stones.

clue.text: Penetrating quality of cry where monster appears

parts.note: to keen is to wail in grief
Loch Ness in Scotland, home of the legendary monster

explanation.surface: A scream goes up where a creature has been sighted.
explanation.definitionFit: Keenness of a blade or mind is its sharpness, a penetrating quality.
